Name: Lost in the Woods - Cannabis Breeding
Author: b42ti0n
Description:
[center]Version 1.2.8
[url=https://ibb.co/LtK6Mjp][img]https://i.ibb.co/0M5Zk4J/Lit-WLogo-transparent.png[/img][/url]

Hey, friend. You a cozy gamer? You a stoner? You wanna combine your passions? Boy is there a mod for you.

[size=3]Lost in the Woods[/size] is a cannabis breeding and processing mod designed by marijuana enthusiasts, for marijuana enthusiasts. Or just casual stoners. Or, like, literally anyone. Whatever floats your boat, brotherman. This mod adds a new shop, an interactable NPC vendor, an additional merchant, a new passive festival, 7 machines, 33 artisan goods, 7 cooking recipes, 7 new status effects, and 153 crops to the base game. 34 of those crops are base strains (+hemp) that can be hybridized using a new machine to create 129 unique hybrid strains. The bud you produce can then be sold or shared as is, or processed into ground cannabis, joints, blunts, stingers, infused oil, or shatter! We did our best to follow real life lineage of strains, so if you have some knowledge on family trees, you might get a head start breeding some rarer strains.

An interactive online [url=https://www.familyecho.com/?c=a0v7uegdhbfpuxhj&f=696582795602291836]family tree[/url]﻿ for the hybrids is now up!

Below you will find a guide to everything in the mod, but if you want more details, check out our [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aDVe03O1tHvnjYtXdYvJwohrDtOU5QfPr2zj-SX1l0U/edit?usp=sharing]player handbook.
[/url][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Cn_VzCWrwzEopxt8UMr935F8nhgBjnWsnx_1aQu9uiU/edit?usp=sharing]Japanese Player Handbook[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/OSHIKAWA]OSHIKAWA[/url]﻿
Handbook updating help from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/haplesslydiversified]haplesslydiversified[/url]﻿
Balancing help from [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/Argendauss/]u/Argendauss[/url]﻿ and our discord members

[size=5][url=https://discord.gg/BXZcP933pC]Join our Discord![/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿[/size][/center]
[left][size=4][b]~CANON-FRIENDLY STRAIN NAMES~[/b][/size]

With 1.1.0, we have canonized strain names! In order to increase the immersion of our mod, we have adjusted strains like NYC Diesel to Zuzu City Diesel, or Hindu Kush to Yoba Kush, as well as created some new canon-friendly cultures to reference in our future updates! A couple in particular, Mitéra (Afghan) and Mooksga T'iin (Matanuska White Valley), are actually references to our own real life cultures. Mitéra is "mother" in Greek, referencing dokida's Cypriot lineage, and Mooksga T'iin is a rough translation of White Valley in Tsimshian, the language of b42ti0n's people! The indigenous people of the Mooksga Wilgyeda Valley will continue to be referenced in our future work, so keep your eyes peeled for more lore.[/left]
[b][size=4]~NEW LOCATION~[/size][/b]

On Spring 7, you will receive a letter giving you hints to find a brand new location: the Lost Woods! This is where you will find the Wonder Wagon, your new neighbor's home and self-run business. Here you can purchase starters to some exclusive strains, hang out with Norville and Rooby, or even catch a festival!

[b][size=4]~NEW SKETCHY MERCHANT~[/size]

[/b]A wise man once said, [url=https://soundcloud.com/open-mike-eagle/doug-stamper-feat-hannibal?in=open-mike-eagle/sets/dark-comedy-1#t=0:02:03]never buy weed from a guy named Mortimer[/url]. Unfortunately, if you want to breed every hybrid, you might have to sacrifice your morals... Just northeast of the Community Center, find this shady individual camped out at the picnic table.

[size=4][b]~NEW PASSIVE FESTIVAL~[/b][/size]

You will also receive a letter from Norville on the 18th of Spring inviting you to a... gathering of sorts. If you take him up on his offer, you can find that he has set up a special pop-up shop for the holiday! Here you can buy starters for some of the rarer breeds - though it will be at an increased price - and a special potted mother you can only get one day a year. Many of your favorite neighborhood stoners will also make an appearance to partake in the festivities, and you can even pick up some decorative paraphernalia!

[b][size=4]~NEW MACHINES~[/size][/b]

You will get letters from Norville containing the recipes for five big craftables we have added:
 + Hybrid Seed Maker  ﻿Farming L1
 + Composting Bin  ﻿     Farming L1
 + Rolling Table     ﻿        ﻿Farming L3
 + Distillation Station   ﻿ Farming L5
 + Grinder     ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  After shipping 3 joints of a single type (from Burnout, Creative, Medical)
...and rest are purchasable:
 + Revegetation Tent   ﻿1,000G at the Wonder Wagon  ﻿  
 + Bonsai Mother  ﻿  ﻿10,000g at the Pop-Up Shop

[size=3]Revegetation Tent[/size]
[size=2]Accepts any bud and rooting gel to create a starter. 80% success rate.

[size=3]Bonsai Mother[/size]
[size=2]Accepts any seedling to create 1-3 starters every 24 hours.[/size][/size]

[size=3]Hybrid Seed Maker[/size]
﻿Accepts 2-3 distinct buds and hybridizes them. It will output a hybrid strain starter.
﻿A full hybrid genealogy cheat sheet is available in our [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aDVe03O1tHvnjYtXdYvJwohrDtOU5QfPr2zj-SX1l0U/edit#heading=h.f0pc1vhtf9pz]player handbook[/url].

[size=3]Compost Bin[/size]
﻿Accepts rotten plants to create basic fertilizer.
﻿Accepts basic fertilizer, fish emulsion, and kelp meal to create quality fertilizer
﻿Accepts perlite, clay, and fish emulsion to create basic retaining soil
﻿Accepts retaining soil, fiber, and kelp meal to create deluxe retaining soil
﻿Accepts any fish to create fish emulsion

[size=3]Rolling Table[/size]
﻿Accepts any bud + rolling paper to create 1 of 3 joints, dependent on strain.
﻿Accepts any ground cannabis + blunt wrap to create 1 of 3 blunts, dependent on strain.

[size=3]Distillation Station[/size]
﻿Accepts any bud + any honey to create shatter.
﻿Accepts any bud + any oil to create strain specific infused oil.

[size=3]Grinder[/size]
﻿Accepts 3 of any bud to create ground cannabis.


[b][size=4]~ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONALITIES~[/size][/b]

[size=3]Dehydrator[/size]
﻿Accepts soggy newspaper to create 3 rolling papers.
﻿Accepts fiber to make a rolling paper.
﻿Accepts hemp to create 2 blunt wraps.

[size=3]Beehouse[/size]
﻿Produces strain specific honey when in proximity to any cannabis.
﻿(this is a baked in functionality, cannabis honey is not required for shatter)

[size=3]Cheese Press[/size]
﻿﻿Accepts any bud and milk to create cannabutter
﻿Accecpts Fruity Pebbles OG bud and milk to create FPOG cannabutter

[size=3]Stovetop[/size]
﻿New cooking recipes available in our [url=http://tinyurl.com/LitWGuide]Player Handbook[/url]!

[b][size=4]~NEW STATUS EFFECTS~[/size][/b]

All strains are tagged with one of the following high types;

[size=3]Creative[/size]
﻿These are the mind highs that always hit right. Perfect for a foraging run or harvest day.

[size=3]Burnout[/size]
﻿Might make your body heavy, but boy does it feel good. Park yourself on a dock and waste the afternoon.

[size=3]Medical[/size]
﻿Just enough to take the edge off and keep you alert. For the long days mining for materials.

[size=3]Ditchweed[/size]
﻿That was just a bad time all around.

[size=3]Cheetah Piss[/size]
﻿Our first 4✯ rarity, gives you a burst of energy to match its namesake.

[size=3]Rainbow Sherb Belts[/size]
Another ﻿4✯ buzz that can replenish some lost health and help you bulk up for the next fight.

[size=3]Cereal Killer[/size]
This ﻿4✯ strain gets your adrenaline pumping and makes your confidence soar.

[b][size=4]~Stoner Valley~[/size][/b]

We are now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32742]Stoner Valley[/url]! The strains from their mod work in our machines using the recipes from their original mod.

﻿Blunts are made on our Rolling Table, Jars are made on our Grinder, and Concentrate is made on our Distillation Station.
﻿Our strains will make Joints on the Auto Wrapper, Ground Cannabis on the Pac-Packer, Shatter on the THC Extractor, and Cannabutter on the Cannabutter    ﻿Collector

[size=3]Cross-mod Hybrids[/size]
  ﻿Blue Christmas (Sour Diesel [LitW] + Sour Diesel [SV] + The Christmas Special  + OG Kush)
﻿Zombie Punch (Zombie Haze + Purple Punch)
Single Scoop (Birthday Cake Kush + Gelato)﻿

[b][size=5]~FAQ~[/size][/b]

[size=3]Do I have to start a new farm?[/size]
﻿While we designed this mod to have immersive integration on a new save file, you can adjust the config settings in our new config menu! Be sure to edit from the title screen, most of our options require the save to reload in order to activate.

[size=3]Why aren't my plants showing up after I updated?[/size]
﻿Because we changed some strain names in 1.1.0, some plants and items will appear as a Null item. These plants will have to be replanted unfortunately, and we suggest timing your update with the change of seasons if you are not planting in a greenhouse. Otherwise, you can replace them using console commands and keep going!
﻿If your plants and items are not loading altogether, this is because we have changed pathing for assets. [b]This is why we tell you to completely delete old versions before updating, not just "Replace Files". [/b]Doing a clean install will fix this. 

[size=3]Is this compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded?[/size]
﻿Yes! We are compatible! We now have [s]config options that allow you to toggle[/s] the mod detect SVE and make changes to Norville's schedule to adjust his location slightly, and everything else should run as normal. Please note, we have not implemented full integration - maybe we'll add gift tastes for some of the new villagers after we've gotten to know them better!

[size=3]What about Lunna?[/size]
[s]﻿There is now a toggle in the mod configuration options to move the warp to a location that doesn't interfere with Lunna's entrance! [/s]We've adjusted the entrance to our mod to be more compatible!

[size=3]What about this other mod?[/size]
﻿We have not tested all compatibilities, but the only possible incompatibilities currently involve map edits. LitW edits the map in the northwest corner of Cindersap Forest for the entrance to our new area. It also uses map locations in Pelican Town and the beach for Norville's schedule. If your mod edits these areas, there may be overlap, but otherwise you should be in the clear. 

[size=3]How do I get [insert strain]?[/size]
﻿We have a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aDVe03O1tHvnjYtXdYvJwohrDtOU5QfPr2zj-SX1l0U/edit?usp=sharing]Player Handbook[/url] with a detailed guide to all hybrids currently in game, as well as the locations to purchase all base starters.

[size=3]Can I upload a translation?[/size]
﻿Absolutely! Just be sure to link back to our mod as a credit and let us know so we can link you here, too! We are planning on adding heart events for Norville, so you might want to hold out until then to avoid updating your translation a lot - but, if you have the fire in your belly, we would greatly appreciate you spreading our mod to farmers fluent in other languages!


[b][size=3]~THANK YOU~[/size][/b]

Thank you to everyone for your avid excitement and support for LitW! It means the world to us. We are having so much fun working on this mod, and all of you are making it even better. Genuinely, thanks!

This is our first mod and we have been stoned out of our minds this whole time, so there will most likely be balance issues and bugs while we learn the ropes. If you notice anything, leave a bug report here on Nexus or in our [url=http://discord.gg/BXZcP933pC]discord channel[/url].
